The day of the Osaka Hai, the first leg of 
her goal, the Spring Senior Triple Crown— 
Marvelous Sunday was brimming with 
motivation before the grand stage.

And naturally so. Awaiting after this was 
the Tenno Sho (Spring), featuring Sakura 
Laurel, who had been running strongly in 
graded stakes, and—

Other talented contenders have also 
declared to run. Marvelous Sunday's heart 
dances in anticipation of the marvelous 
race that awaits ahead.

To build momentum for the next race, let's 
first give it everything we've got in the 
Osaka Hai.
